name: @cyclone-ui/container
description: A themed surface Container that wraps content in a padded, rounded box. Variants include primary, secondary, tertiary, outlined, sunken, canvas, surface, elevated (the default) and floating. It also has size-based padding, shadow styles, and circular, tight and accented options, a glass option that turns the background into translucent frosted glass, and a noise option that overlays a fine film grain. Use it for cards and panels.
